title: Antigravity CLI: observed canonical transcript step
description: One step in Antigravity CLI canonical transcript.jsonl. Not the diagnostic transcript_full.jsonl or IDE conversation protobuf. This is a partial observational reference, not a vendor-certified or lossless ingestion schema. Unknown properties are allowed.

step_index.description: Native step index used to derive indexed message identity.

source.description: Recorded source; USER_EXPLICIT and MODEL are recognized for conversation.

type.description: Step kind; USER_INPUT and PLANNER_RESPONSE are indexed.

status.description: Recorded step status; reviewed importer includes only DONE.

created_at.description: Recorded timestamp string; preserve original representation, parse only when valid.

content.description: Step content. The reviewed importer only accepts string-valued conversation content.
